data.narrative:
Crusoe Energy is a Series E AI & Software company founded by Chase Lochmiller and Cully Cavness, currently valued at $10B+ with $3B+ raised to date. The peer comparison universe consists of 3 same-stage, same-sector private companies (SandboxAQ at $5.8B, Ayar Labs at $3.8B, and Palantir at $312.5B) alongside a broader set of 9 private frontier-tech comparables and 1 public peer (Palantir, ticker PLTR).

Two valuation methods triangulate Crusoe's fair value. Stage-progression analysis applies a 1.4x step-up multiplier to the last post-money valuation of $10.0B, implying $14.0B. Peer-median benchmarking across the 3 same-stage, same-sector companies yields a median of $5.8B, though with substantial dispersion (range $3.8B to $312.5B, driven largely by Palantir's outsized valuation). The peer-median method implies $5.8B.

Triangulation across both methods produces a valuation range of $4.9B (floor) to $16.1B (ceiling), with a median of $9.9B. The current $10B+ valuation sits near the midpoint. Key uncertainties include the appropriate weighting of Palantir—a structural outlier within the peer set—and stage-progression multiplier sensitivity, as Series E step-ups in frontier-tech vary materially with capital market conditions and company-specific growth trajectories.
